tasks.label: Stop Bridge Server
tasks.command: $listenPid = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess); if ($listenPid) { Stop-Process -Id $listenPid -Force }

tasks.label: Restart Bridge Server
tasks.command: $listenPid = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8765 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess); if ($listenPid) { Stop-Process -Id $listenPid -Force }; .\.venv312\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn edocat_bridge.app.server:app --app-dir src --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
